sources.use: Massive all-red bill, maroon shoulder, male neck collar, grey feet; native range distinct from introduced HK; NT decreasing, global assessment not local rarity.
Rose-ringed male black/pink collar but no maroon shoulder; lower bill largely black, smaller bill; yellow-white iris and yellow eyering.
Red-breasted male red upper bill, grey-blue head, salmon chest, black moustache.
Red-breasted grey head with black moustache and pink-red breast.
